_comment: UAE -> Switzerland booking flow. THE FIRST ROUTE BUILT FROM REAL DOM rather than guesswork — every selector below was captured from a live invited account (switzerland_booking/switzerland.html, 2026-09-03). Where the base config guesses, this file states.
_comment_enabled: Still OFF. The steps below are real as far as /che/services, but nothing past it has been seen — no review page, no payment. A route is armed only once its WHOLE flow is known, because the committing step is what decides whether a run can be abandoned safely.
_comment_why_che_first: Switzerland needs no OTP (only AE-GRC sets "otp": true in config/routes/), so a probe here exercises the booking flow without also depending on OTP mail arriving. Fewer moving parts while the selectors are being proven.

row._comment_reference: Switzerland's references are SWDB + digits (SWDB80857698379, SWDB79923880977) — a FOUR-letter prefix, where Greece and Italy use three. The base keeps a loose pattern for routes whose format is unknown; this one is exact.
row._comment_open: A CSS SELECTOR, not a role lookup. The base config guessed {"role": "button", "name": "Book Now"} on the theory that the accessible name is what gets matched — but this is a bare with no role attribute and no ARIA, so get_by_role('button') finds nothing and the walk died on a 30s timeout with the element plainly on screen. REAL DOM 2026-09-25: Book Now . The :has-text() guard matters because c-brand-orange is VFS's generic accent class and also dresses 'Manage Application' on the same card. dom_utils' click ladder (normal -> force -> JS) handles a span that ignores a plain click.
row._comment_status: The same row carries 'Waitlist Status: SLOTS AVAILABLE'. That text — not the presence of the button — is what the probe treats as 'invited'.
row._comment_container: REAL DOM, captured from a live invited account 2026-09-25. Plain Bootstrap — NOT app-appointment-card, .application-card or mat-card, all of which the default guessed and none of which exist on this page. The probe reported 'this account holds no applications' about an account whose dashboard plainly showed one. 'mb-20' is what separates the application card from the page's two other .card elements.
row._comment_blocked: *** THE BOOK NOW SPAN CAN BE PRESENT AND STILL DEAD. *** On 2026-09-25 it rendered as Book Now while the page said 'The visa application form for all the applicants must be completed to book an appointment' and the card said 'Visa Application form Status - Not Initiated'. Waitlist Status still read SLOTS AVAILABLE. So 'invited' and 'bookable' are NOT the same state: a runner that keys off the status text alone would click a disabled span, see nothing happen, and report a lost race it never entered. Treat this class as a refusal to proceed.

steps.name: verify_identity
steps._comment: Inherited unchanged. The reference read off the card is compared against the one stored at registration; Switzerland's SWDB numbers are already in the journal from real registrations, so this join works today.

steps.name: appointment_details
steps._comment: REMOVED. The base assumes booking re-visits an Appointment Details form; Switzerland does not. 'Book Now' goes straight to /che/book-appointment, which is the calendar. Confirmed from the real flow.

steps.name: select_slot
steps._comment: https://visa.vfsglobal.com/are/en/che/book-appointment — the calendar AND the time-slot table on one page. Both are chosen here, then Continue.

appointment_type._comment: 'Pick an Appointment Type' offers a single radio labelled 'Choose a slot', already selected in the captured page. Declared so a portal offering several types can name which one; left as the visible label rather than an id, which is positional here.
appointment_type.label: Choose a slot

calendar._comment: FullCalendar (the fullcalendar.io library), NOT Angular Material. So none of the mat-calendar selectors in the base apply.
calendar._comment_available_day:
*** date-availiable IS SPELLED WITH THREE i's IN VFS'S OWN MARKUP. *** It is their typo, not one here, and it must be matched verbatim — 'correcting' it to date-available matches nothing and the run finds no slots at all. The inner
availiable
carries the same misspelling.
calendar._comment_date_attribute: Every cell carries data-date="2026-09-07". That is an EXACT date selector — far better than clicking a day number, which is ambiguous across months and breaks on the greyed-out leading/trailing cells that show no date at all.
calendar._comment_unavailable: An unavailable day is a plain td.fc-daygrid-day with no date-availiable class and no event child. Days outside the month carry fc-day-disabled and no data-date.

time_slots._comment: A table below the calendar, populated after a date is clicked. REAL DOM: <table class="table ba-slot-table">, one <tr> per time.
time_slots._comment_row: The class reads 'hidden-item' but these are the VISIBLE slot rows in the captured page — presumably an Angular animation class. Do not filter them out on the name.
time_slots._comment_time: td id='tv0' -> 11:15, 'tv1' -> 11:30, 'tv2' -> 11:45. The id index is the row number, and the text is the time.
time_slots._comment_select: The <input type="radio" class="ba-slot-radio"> is tabindex=-1 and visually replaced by its label, so the LABEL is what must be clicked. Clicking the input directly is intercepted.
time_slots._comment_strategy: Take the first offered time. The slot is NOT held while the remaining steps run, so speed matters more than preference — a competitor may take it at any moment.

steps._comment_commits: PROVISIONAL, and it is almost certainly wrong. Selecting a slot reserves NOTHING — the booking is confirmed only when payment completes. This flag sits here solely because config.py requires exactly one committing step and the payment step does not exist yet. MOVE IT to payment once that page is captured.

steps.name: services
steps._comment: https://visa.vfsglobal.com/are/en/che/services — an optional add-on services page. NOTHING TO DO on it for Switzerland: scroll to the bottom and Continue.
steps._comment_scroll: The Continue button sits below the fold. Without scrolling, the click misses.

steps.name: confirmation
steps._comment: REMOVED for now — NOT because Switzerland has no confirmation, but because nothing past /che/services has been captured. The base's confirmation step is a guess, and a guessed step at the END of a flow is the most dangerous kind: it would read some other page as success. Better to have the run stop at a page it does not recognise. Re-add it with real selectors once the pages after Continue are known.

_comment_flow_so_far: Dashboard 'Book Now' -> /che/book-appointment (pick date, pick time, Continue) -> /che/services (scroll, Continue) -> ??? -> payment (new window/tab) -> confirmed. The '???' is the gap: the user reports 5-6 steps in total, and only two are captured.
_comment_next: To finish this route: walk on from /che/services with --keep-open and capture each remaining page's DOM. Then move "commits" to the payment step and set "enabled": true.
